data.methodology_note: Zero-Fitting Anti-Cherry-Picking Audit of Bean qou-l4t2 (Two-Loop O(alpha_EM^2) Structure of 1/alpha_EM): (1) All-Order Habiro-Dyson Resummation vs. Form-B Truncation: Resumming the 1PI geometric Habiro self-energy series 1 - h^2 alpha + h^4 alpha^2 - ... = 1 / (1 + h^2 alpha) yields the quadratic Dyson equation (T h^2 + H) alpha^2 + (T - h^2) alpha - 1 = 0. The exact all-order Habiro tail 1/alpha_DysonResum - 1/alpha_FormB = h^4 H alpha^3 / (1 + h^2 alpha) equals +5.9373e-11 (+0.4333 ppt = +0.0028 sigma_CODATA), proving that higher powers h^{2k} alpha^k (k >= 2) are completely negligible below 0.5 ppt. However, deriving from first principles why the 1PI Bring-Schwinger photon propagator carries the repulsive (+h^2 alpha) denominator 1/(1 + h^2 alpha) rather than the bare Form-A vertex (1/alpha = T + alpha H) remains a primary formal target. (2) Exact Tree-Level Pin Sensitivity C'(q): The tree capacity C(q) = q [9]_q [10]_q has exact derivative C'(q_0) = +843.641860..., giving total fixed-point sensitivity d(1/alpha)/dq = +843.638319... Because subtracting the proton's +0.220 keV Borromean V^3 QED self-energy shifts the substrate pin from q_0 (1-term proton) to q_2t (2-term Borromean proton) by +11.171 ppb (+1.240e-8 in q), the tree term C(q) shifts 1/alpha_EM upward by +0.000010461 (+76.335 ppb). (3) Candid Verdict on the Pre-Registered Two-Loop Delta_2 Census: At the 1-term proton pin q_0, the residual against CODATA-2022 is tiny (Delta_2_req(q_0) = +4.9990e-8 = +0.00927 (alpha/pi)^2, c_2_req = +0.0009388, and even Cand_0_zero sits at 137.03599912701, strictly between Rb-2020 137.035999206 and Cs-2018 137.035999046, while the nearest non-zero pre-registered candidate Cand_5c_hbar_over_3pi2_plus c_2 = +hbar_q / (3 pi^2) = +0.0033464 overshoots to +0.936 ppb = +6.11 sigma_CODATA). At the QED-subtracted 2-term Borromean proton pin q_2t (and ideal muon pin q_muon), closing the -1.0411e-5 (-75.97 ppb) offset requires c_2_req(q_2t) = -0.195501 (i.e. c_2 * pi^2 = -1.9295, or Delta_2 = -1.9295 (alpha/pi)^2; at q_muon, c_2 * pi^2 = -2.0064). In the pre-registered zero-fitting census, the largest natural negative candidates without ad-hoc integer multipliers are Cand_1b_qed_jost_luttinger_minus (c_2 * pi^2 = -3/4 = -0.7500, leaving +46.44 ppb at q_2t) and Cand_4b_bloch_trilog_Li3_minus (c_2 * pi^2 = -Li_3(q^{-2}) = -0.9263, leaving +39.50 ppb at q_2t). No single parameter-free candidate in the pre-registered census closes the q_2t/q_muon -1.93 (alpha/pi)^2 offset without an un-derived multiplicity factor (~ 2.08 x Li_3(q^{-2}) or ~ 2.57 x Jost-Luttinger); thus the two-loop coefficient Delta_2 (and its reconciliation with the q_0 -> q_2t pin shift) remains a genuinely open first-principles derivation problem (Bean qou-l4t2).
